title: 第25章 林战遇袭第26章 地下血窟
lines: “这林战也没有像柳河说得那样有什么特殊之处嘛，
就是一个稍微强大一点儿的化海境七重之人罢了，
竟然还花费大代价请我出手，简直就是可笑至极！”
不错，此人正是柳家供奉的那位化海境巅峰之境的血魔窟外门执事。
“这样的家伙，我一只手就能灭杀，不过我还是需要小心一些，
听柳家大长老柳河说他手中还有一件威力强大的九宫阵盘！
这东西若是让他施展开来，
恐怕就算是身为化海境巅峰之境的我也会遭受重创啊！”
想到这里，柳无涯再次等待着出手的机会！
而林战一直坐在书房椅子上看着手中典籍，
就这样一个在房间之中看书，一个趴伏在屋顶等待着机会！
许久之后，就在柳无涯即将失去耐心之时，林战动了，
只见林战伸了个懒腰，然后起身准备朝着书房外走去。
“机会来了！”
柳无涯见此暗道一声。
随后，只见柳无涯枯瘦的指尖凝出三滴黑血，
正欲透过瓦缝弹向林战后颈，却见那卷《南离药典》突然迸发青芒。
林战翻书的右手骤然泛起龙鳞状纹路，
整个书房地面浮现出纵横交错的金色网格——
九宫阵盘竟早已在檀香袅绕间悄然运转！
血影分空！
柳无涯暴喝声未落，三十六道血影已如毒蛇窜入屋内。
每道血影手中白骨刃皆刺向不同卦位，暗合九宫杀劫之数。
林战手中书卷陡然炸裂，碎页化作金蝶封住乾、坤二门，
身形如游鱼般滑至巽位阵眼。
血刃斩在突然升起的青铜阵壁上，
迸发的火星竟化作符咒贴在柳无涯面具。
密室四角同时亮起兽首灯盏，貔貅吞吐的烟霞里浮现出八十一枚悬浮卦签。
柳无涯突然发现脚下血影正在卦象中扭曲——这
九宫阵竟能倒映心魔！
好个林家之主！
没想到你竟然早就发现我了！
白骨面具裂开蛛网状纹路，柳无涯周身爆开血茧，
七只紫纹骨手破茧而出，
且看是你的阵法卦象快，还是我的《血魔饲骨诀》狠！
第三只骨手突然捏碎坎位阵旗，血池虚影自破损处汹涌漫入。
林战肩头罡气被腐蚀得滋滋作响，却反手将阵盘核心拍入地面。
霎时地板上浮现出旋转的星图，
二十八宿方位同时射出锁链缠住柳无涯脚踝。
九宫变·天狱镇魔！
content_en:
"This Lin Zhan doesn't have anything special like Liu He said.
He's just a slightly stronger person at the seventh level of the Sea Transformation Realm.
You actually spent a lot of money to ask me to take action, which is simply ridiculous! "
Yes, this person is the deacon of the outer gate of the Blood Demon Cave who is at the peak of the Sea Transformation Realm enshrined by the Liu family.
"I can kill such a guy with one hand, but I still need to be careful.
I heard Liu He, the eldest elder of the Liu family, said that he also had a powerful Nine Palace Formation Disk in his hand!
If he were allowed to unfold this thing,
I'm afraid that even if I am at the peak of the Sea Transformation Realm, I will suffer heavy losses! "
Thinking of this, Liu Wuya once again waited for the opportunity to take action!
Lin Zhan had been sitting on a chair in the study room, looking at the classics in his hands.
Just like this, one is reading in the room, and the other is lying on the roof, waiting for the opportunity!
After a long time, just when Liu Wuya was about to lose his patience, Lin Zhan made a move.
I saw Lin Zhan stretching, then getting up and preparing to walk out of the study.
"The opportunity has come!"
Liu Wuya secretly thought when he saw this.
Then, I saw three drops of black blood condensed on Liu Wuya’s skinny fingertips,
Just as he was about to shoot Lin Zhan's neck through the cracks in the tiles, he saw a green light suddenly burst out from the "Nanli Pharmacopoeia".
Lin Zhan's right hand when he turned the book suddenly appeared with dragon scale-like lines.
A criss-crossing golden grid emerged on the entire study floor——
The Nine Palace Formation Disk has already been quietly rotating among the sandalwood curls!
Blood and shadow separate the sky!
Before Liu Wuya shouted loudly, thirty-six blood shadows scurried into the house like poisonous snakes.
The white bone blades in each blood shadow's hand are piercing different hexagram positions, which coincides with the number of killings and calamities in the nine palaces.
The book in Lin Zhan's hand suddenly exploded, and the broken pages turned into golden butterflies, sealing the Qian and Kun gates.
The body slides like a swimming fish to the Xun position.
The bloody blade struck the suddenly rising bronze formation wall,
The sparks that burst out turned into charms and stuck on Liu Wuya's mask.
The four corners of the secret room lighted up the beast-head lamps at the same time, and eighty-one floating hexagrams emerged from the haze puffed out by Pai Yao.
Liu Wuya suddenly found that the blood shadow under his feet was distorting in the hexagram - this
The Nine Palace Formation can actually reflect the inner demons!
What a master of the Lin family!
I didn’t expect you to have discovered me so early!
The white bone mask cracked with spider web-like patterns, and a cocoon of blood exploded all over Liu Wuya's body.
Seven purple-striped bone hands emerged from their cocoons,
Let's see whether your formation hexagrams are fast or my "Blood Demon Bone Feeding Technique" is ruthless!
The third skeletal hand suddenly crushed the formation flag, and the shadow of the blood pool surged in from the damaged area.
The Gang Qi on Lin Zhan's shoulders was corroded so loudly that he slapped the core of the array into the ground with his backhand.
Suddenly, a rotating star map appeared on the floor.
At the same time, chains were shot out from the twenty-eight-star position and wrapped around Liu Wuya's ankles.
Nine Palace Transformation·Heavenly Prison Suppresses Demons!
title_en: Chapter 25 Lin Zhan is attacked Chapter 26 Underground Blood Cave
